In these petitions, petitioners seek quashing of the impugned proceedings arising out of Fir
registered in Crime No.71/2023 dated 06.07.2023 which is currently pending in C.C.No.1770/2024
before the trial Court.
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned HCGP for respondent No.1 and perused the material on record.
Respondent No.2-de-facto complainant - Smt.Swathi.M having been served with notice of the petitions, has chosen to remain unrepresented and has not contested the petitions.
NC: 2025:KHC:19609 HC-KAR 3.

A perusal of the material on record would indicate that the second respondent - complainant is the wife of one Manjunath who is arrayed as accused No.1 in the impugned proceedings in which accused Nos.2 to 7 are the family members of the aforesaid Manjunath who have preferred Crl.P.No.11160/2023.
So also, the petitioner in Crl.P.No.10271/2024 alleged to be the girl friend of the aforesaid Manjunath and she is arrayed as accused No.8 in the impugned proceedings.

4. A perusal of the material on record comprising of the complaint, FIR, charge sheet materials,
statement of witnesses, document etc., would indicate that the offences alleged against the petitioners who are the family members of accused No.1, Manjunath, who is the husband of the defacto complainant and the petitioner - Swapna Nayar, revolves primarily around the allegation under Section 498A of IPC and ancillary offences.
